name: Voltaire Leasing & Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Voltaire Leasing & Finance Ltd is in the business of Financing & Investment activities in Shares & Securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
VLFL is in the business of finance and trading, hire purchase, leasing and to finance leasing operations of all kinds, purchasing, selling, letting on hire plant & machinery. The company is currently involved in investment in Shares & Securities and temporary Corporate Funding. It is carrying trading /investment activities in both Equity and FNO Segment of both BSE and NSE. Company also deals in Commercial Papers, Fixed Deposits and other related activities of capital market

pros: Stock is trading at 0.28 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.17% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 1,302 days to 3,909 days
